newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA C.BANK CORRECTS ANNUAL RATE TO 9.76 PCT.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA C.BANK CORRECTS ANNUAL RATE TO 9.76 PCT.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank on Friday corrected the simple main annual interest rate to 9.76 percent instead of 9.56 percent announced on Thursday, a BNB spokesman said.

"There was a technical error in the interest rate cut announcement yesterday. The correct simple main annual interest rate is 9.76 percent, from 10.12 percent now," BNB spokesman Kostadin Georgiev told Reuters. The new rate is effective from July 7.
A BNB statement said on Thursday that the BNB had set the main simple annual rate at 9.56 percent as of July 7.
A commercial bank dealer said they received a BNB statement on Friday saying that the 9.56 percent rate figure was wrong and that the correct figure was 9.76 percent.
The rate is calculated on the average yield to maturity on three-month discount T-bills. The average yield to maturity on three-month discount T-bills auctioned on Monday was 2.46 percent.
A week ago the BNB set the simple main rate at 10.12 percent, shadowing an excessive lev liqidity on the domestic money market.

Interest rates have come down to 0.81 percent monthly from 18 percent in March, reflecting a stabilisation trend of the economy following an IMF reform and funding deal reached in March. On Tuesday Bulgaria entered a restrictive fixed exchange rate regime aimed at restoring confidence in the financial system.
